environment.application: local PAPER API and production-built Mission Control
environment.credentials: synthetic local operator credential; value omitted

checks.name: destination dialog focus containment
observations: The native dialog opened in modal state with focus on its search input.
Five Tab presses moved to a destination link contained within the dialog.
Twenty-four additional Tab presses kept focus inside the dialog.

checks.name: destination dialog close and shortcut at 320px
observations: Escape closed the dialog and restored focus to the trigger.
Ctrl+K reopened the modal and focused its input.
Document width remained 320px for a 320px viewport.

checks.name: authenticated Risk Center keyboard path
observations: Tab moved from the mobile Menu control to the operator access input and then Sign in; Enter established the synthetic local session.
After sign-in, Tab reached Sign out, the paper safety selector, the reason field, the re-authentication field, and the instrument selector in order.
The disabled safety-action button was skipped; no safety action was submitted.

checks.name: sign-out and protected session state
observations: Sign out returned the UI to the signed-out state.
A post-sign-out protected session read returned HTTP 401.
The explicit 401 browser fetch emitted one expected failed-resource console entry; the preceding application interaction check had zero console errors or warnings.

limitations: This is a scoped local browser acceptance probe, not independent accessibility certification.
Manual screen-reader review and other authenticated workflows remain open.
The checks do not establish production deployment, broker eligibility, or P13 release readiness.
